limitations: Different metrics and conditional denominators cannot be averaged into a four-dimension overall accuracy.
Spatial geometry proxies and physical detector reruns are separate; signed geometry gains are deterministic backend gains.
Action uses the existing 60-pair synonym lexicon; model-only and output-normalization-only ablations remain separate.
Scene and Objects evaluation labels are model consensus, not independent human ground truth.
Objects temporal confirmation suppresses positives by abstaining and also loses visible detections; persistent errors remain.
Current tests were already inspected; follow-up repairs are not independent blind evaluations.
No new training, inference, or scoring was performed for this consolidation.
